summary: Arcane to Arcane Power with Arcane Blast and Missile Barrage, on the Arcane gear variant (Gloves - Arcane Power). 8% behind Frostfire.
rotation: Pre-pull: Arcane Blast at -2.5 s so it lands at the pull
Cooldowns (Arcane Power, Presence of Mind, Demonic Rune) on a free GCD; mana gems never
Below 30% mana: one Arcane Blast, then Arcane Missiles
Arcane Missiles on a Missile Barrage proc once Arcane Blast has 2 stacks
Filler: Arcane Missiles (ends the stacks and takes their bonus)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 41 spell power and 11 crit rating, and 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Arcane Blast's bonus on Arcane Missiles: 10% per tooltip; client 400573 excludes Missiles and 400586 gives 15%
Arcane Concentration on missile ticks with a 1 s internal cooldown (assumed)
The 15 Frost points do nothing for this rotation
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Fireball XI, Frostbolt X, Arcane Missiles VII); with the books Frost +50, Arcane +30, Fire +17, Frostfire 0
notes: Request written by mksettings -spec mage_arcane unchanged (shared level 60 raid with Mana Spring Totem and Blessing of Wisdom in place of Might; Mage Armor; Engineering/Tailoring).
